knowledge.title: Node.js 22 Native TypeScript Strip-Types Compatibility Standard
knowledge.summary: Server execution uses Node 22 native type stripping; object literals with as const must replace enum declarations.
knowledge.content: In server runtime, TypeScript enums cause SyntaxError under --experimental-strip-types. Always express categories as `export const RoleCategory = { ... } as const; export type RoleCategory = (typeof RoleCategory)[keyof typeof RoleCategory];`

knowledge.title: Zero-Trust Tool Gateway Invocation Protocol
knowledge.summary: No virtual employee may invoke external APIs or file writes without passing through the ToolGateway risk calculator.
knowledge.content: Actions classified as HIGH or CRITICAL risk require explicit approval queue logging. All secrets in prompt inputs are automatically redacted prior to LLM forwarding.

knowledge.title: Operational Best Practice: Single-Point Approval Bottleneck on Production Deployments Remediation
knowledge.summary: Problem: Elena Vance and Hank Tate must approve every minor configuration patch; active workload is 94% with 14 blocked tasks queued. | Solution: Establish Risk-Weighted Autonomous Delegation policy; delegate non-breaking config checks to autonomous verification sub-agents.
knowledge.content:
Problem: Elena Vance and Hank Tate must approve every minor configuration patch; active workload is 94% with 14 blocked tasks queued.
Root Cause: Monolithic authorization rules require Executive Level 80+ sign-off even for low-risk linting and test pipeline updates.
Solution: Establish Risk-Weighted Autonomous Delegation policy; delegate non-breaking config checks to autonomous verification sub-agents.
Metrics: Queue latency: 24 hrs (Workload > 90%) -> Queue latency: < 45 seconds (Workload re-balanced to 55%)

knowledge.title: Operational Best Practice: Redundant Daily Multi-Service Health & Dependency Scans Remediation
knowledge.summary: Problem: Engineers manually trigger the same microservice health verification and port mapping scripts 42 times per day across 6 environments. | Solution: Deploy persistent Cron telemetry daemon with reactive websocket invalidation and deduplicated semantic state cache.
knowledge.content:
Problem: Engineers manually trigger the same microservice health verification and port mapping scripts 42 times per day across 6 environments.
Root Cause: Absence of an event-driven telemetry daemon; agents manually query state whenever preparing deployment batches.
Solution: Deploy persistent Cron telemetry daemon with reactive websocket invalidation and deduplicated semantic state cache.
Metrics: 42 manual runs/day (16.5 hrs/wk) -> 0 manual runs (100% automated daemon with 98.4% cache hit rate)

knowledge.title: Operational Best Practice: Repetitive Customer Persona & Compliance Policy Synthesis Remediation
knowledge.summary: Problem: Marketing and Legal repeatedly regenerate identical GDPR/CCPA clause interpretations for new product brief templates. | Solution: Index pre-compiled compliance briefs into Layered Knowledge Vector Store with zero-shot retrieval.
knowledge.content:
Problem: Marketing and Legal repeatedly regenerate identical GDPR/CCPA clause interpretations for new product brief templates.
Root Cause: No shared corporate knowledge index for ratified legal policy snippets; models are prompted from zero context each time.
Solution: Index pre-compiled compliance briefs into Layered Knowledge Vector Store with zero-shot retrieval.
Metrics: 19 manual runs/day (8 hrs/wk) -> 0 manual runs (100% automated daemon with 98.4% cache hit rate)

knowledge.title: Operational Best Practice: Financial Model Run Serialization on GPU Sandbox Remediation
knowledge.summary: Problem: All budget forecasting simulations run on a single synchronous worker thread, causing 4-hour queues during fiscal close. | Solution: Configure multi-instance parallel worker pool with ephemeral compute environments for concurrent Monte Carlo simulations.
knowledge.content:
Problem: All budget forecasting simulations run on a single synchronous worker thread, causing 4-hour queues during fiscal close.
Root Cause: Lack of worker thread pooling in sandbox environment manager for financial computations.
Solution: Configure multi-instance parallel worker pool with ephemeral compute environments for concurrent Monte Carlo simulations.
Metrics: Queue latency: 4 hrs (Workload > 90%) -> Queue latency: < 45 seconds (Workload re-balanced to 55%)

knowledge.title: Operational Best Practice: Full Context Window Dump on Routine Log Triaging Remediation
knowledge.summary: Problem: System dumps 128k raw log tokens directly into reasoning models without pre-filtering, consuming $4,600/month in avoidable LLM compute. | Solution: Implement local deterministic regex & AST error-slicing filter before model invocation, reducing context by 85%.
knowledge.content:
Problem: System dumps 128k raw log tokens directly into reasoning models without pre-filtering, consuming $4,600/month in avoidable LLM compute.
Root Cause: Raw regex and error extraction not performed prior to model prompt construction.
Solution: Implement local deterministic regex & AST error-slicing filter before model invocation, reducing context by 85%.
Metrics: 1,28,000 tokens/run ($4,600/mo) -> 18,200 tokens/run ($828/mo)

knowledge.title: Operational Best Practice: Redundant Multi-Model Reasoning Consensus on Low-Risk Tasks Remediation
knowledge.summary: Problem: Minor calendar adjustments and markdown formatting tasks invoke full 3-model cross-evaluation consensus loops. | Solution: Introduce dynamic Complexity-Scored Model Routing (Flash for routine updates, Consensus only for High/Critical risk).
knowledge.content:
Problem: Minor calendar adjustments and markdown formatting tasks invoke full 3-model cross-evaluation consensus loops.
Root Cause: Orchestrator lacked task-complexity tiered routing; applied heavy executive consensus blindly.
Solution: Introduce dynamic Complexity-Scored Model Routing (Flash for routine updates, Consensus only for High/Critical risk).
Metrics: 64,000 tokens/run ($2,950/mo) -> 18,200 tokens/run ($531/mo)

knowledge.title: Operational Best Practice: Sequential Product Research & Competitive Intelligence Pipeline Remediation
knowledge.summary: Problem: Competitor indexing, feature matrix extraction, and patent review run sequentially across 9 serial phases, taking 38 minutes per run. | Solution: Refactor workflow DAG into Fan-Out / Fan-In asynchronous execution matrix with concurrent web explorers.
knowledge.content:
Problem: Competitor indexing, feature matrix extraction, and patent review run sequentially across 9 serial phases, taking 38 minutes per run.
Root Cause: Pipeline steps are chained via linear awaits instead of concurrent Promise.all / message pub-sub fans.
Solution: Refactor workflow DAG into Fan-Out / Fan-In asynchronous execution matrix with concurrent web explorers.
Metrics: 38 minutes execution time -> 1.4 minutes execution time (Parallel multi-agent execution)

knowledge.title: Operational Best Practice: Quarterly Financial Variance Reporting Pipeline Remediation
knowledge.summary: Problem: Reconciling ledger data with departmental projections requires 5 sequential batch syncs with 10-minute idle sleep timeouts. | Solution: Implement immediate state-change trigger webhooks, dropping end-to-end variance generation to 90 seconds.
knowledge.content:
Problem: Reconciling ledger data with departmental projections requires 5 sequential batch syncs with 10-minute idle sleep timeouts.
Root Cause: Arbitrary sleep polling instead of reactive event-driven webhooks when balance tables update.
Solution: Implement immediate state-change trigger webhooks, dropping end-to-end variance generation to 90 seconds.
Metrics: 60 minutes execution time -> 1.4 minutes execution time (Parallel multi-agent execution)

knowledge.title: Operational Best Practice: Intermittent Third-Party Web Search Tool Gateway Rate Limits Remediation
knowledge.summary: Problem: Uncoordinated parallel tool calls burst into 429 Too Many Requests errors, causing 18.5% of research queries to fail and abort. | Solution: Implement Adaptive Token-Bucket Leaky-Bucket Rate Limiter with jittered exponential backoff and alternate provider fallback.
knowledge.content:
Problem: Uncoordinated parallel tool calls burst into 429 Too Many Requests errors, causing 18.5% of research queries to fail and abort.
Root Cause: Absence of token-bucket rate limiting and exponential backoff retry jitter on the research gateway client.
Solution: Implement Adaptive Token-Bucket Leaky-Bucket Rate Limiter with jittered exponential backoff and alternate provider fallback.
Metrics: 18.5% failure rate -> 0.02% failure rate with automatic self-healing fallback

knowledge.title: Operational Best Practice: Sandbox Container Memory OOM on Heavy Code Lint Passes Remediation
knowledge.summary: Problem: Full repository AST generation exceeds the default 512MB memory boundary during large pull requests, killing the process. | Solution: Dynamic workspace scaling; inspect target file manifest and dynamically allocate container memory tiers (512MB - 4GB).
knowledge.content:
Problem: Full repository AST generation exceeds the default 512MB memory boundary during large pull requests, killing the process.
Root Cause: Fixed container memory caps regardless of workspace repository size or file count.
Solution: Dynamic workspace scaling; inspect target file manifest and dynamically allocate container memory tiers (512MB - 4GB).
Metrics: 12% failure rate -> 0.02% failure rate with automatic self-healing fallback

knowledge.title: Operational Best Practice: Manual Copy-Pasting of API Gateway Endpoint Specs into Docs Remediation
knowledge.summary: Problem: Staff manually inspect OpenAPI schemas and copy markdown tables into knowledge base articles, introducing human typos. | Solution: Automate zero-touch OpenAPI doc generator that synchronizes directly with the Corporate Knowledge Graph upon build.
knowledge.content:
Problem: Staff manually inspect OpenAPI schemas and copy markdown tables into knowledge base articles, introducing human typos.
Root Cause: Documentation engine lacked an automated Swagger/OpenAPI AST introspection hook on git commits.
Solution: Automate zero-touch OpenAPI doc generator that synchronizes directly with the Corporate Knowledge Graph upon build.
Metrics: 15 hrs/wk manual intervention -> 0 hrs manual intervention (Zero-touch automated pass)

knowledge.title: Operational Best Practice: Manual Verification Gate for Low-Risk Staging Cache Clears Remediation
knowledge.summary: Problem: Cache invalidations require a human operator confirmation prompt in Slack, delaying automated deployment tests by up to 2 hours. | Solution: Upgrade policy rule to automatically approve staging-environment invalidations with deterministic audit logging.
knowledge.content:
Problem: Cache invalidations require a human operator confirmation prompt in Slack, delaying automated deployment tests by up to 2 hours.
Root Cause: Overly conservative policy classified non-destructive staging Redis FLUSHDB as requiring manual multi-factor signoff.
Solution: Upgrade policy rule to automatically approve staging-environment invalidations with deterministic audit logging.
Metrics: 6 hrs/wk manual intervention -> 0 hrs manual intervention (Zero-touch automated pass)

workflows.definitionName: Incident Response Simulation: Synthetic Credential Exposure
workflows.description: Local tabletop exercise using a synthetic alert. No real credential, customer, vendor, cloud account, or external system is involved.

steps.title: Correlate local threat intelligence
steps.taskDescription: Review only the synthetic alert and locally available evidence; identify confirmed facts, unknowns, and scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Separate observed facts from assumptions
Do not browse external sources or contact third parties

outputResult.evidenceSummary: Operator evidence: reviewed only the built-in synthetic scenario and its local acceptance criteria. No real credential, indicator, account identifier, or source telemetry was supplied, so an actual exposure and its scope remain unknown. No external source was queried and no containment action was performed.

steps.title: Assess severity and recommend containment
steps.taskDescription: Classify the synthetic credential-exposure alert and document a reversible containment recommendation.
acceptanceCriteria: Record severity and rationale
Do not revoke credentials or change network access

outputResult.evidenceSummary: Operator assessment (synthetic exercise only): severity is not assessable for a real incident because no genuine alert, credential, indicators, affected account, or telemetry was provided. For the tabletop, recommend preserving evidence and using a reversible quarantine of a test identity in an isolated lab only after the alert is validated. No production credential was revoked and no network or account state was changed.

steps.title: Implement and test local incident tooling
steps.taskDescription: Implement deterministic incident-response task assignment, evidence recording, secret redaction, and approval gates.
acceptanceCriteria: Type-check the implementation
Test sequential task transitions and the executive approval gate

outputResult.evidenceSummary: Operator verification (not independent agent execution): implemented server/incidents/incident-response.ts and tests/incident-response.test.ts. Local type-check passed; incident, memory, and chat-format checks passed 9/9; production build passed. Evidence source is the local command output and the listed repository artifacts. No deployment or external API call was performed.

steps.title: Review AI and model-routing telemetry
steps.taskDescription: Assess the supplied local model/provider status and list relevant gaps without inferring a compromise.
acceptanceCriteria: Use only collected local status evidence
Do not invoke unavailable providers or external APIs

outputResult.evidenceSummary: Operator configuration check: GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, OLLAMA_HOST, VITE_SUPABASE_URL, and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY are unset in this process. No model/provider API was called. Provider availability, routing health, and any external telemetry remain unverified; no compromise is inferred from missing configuration.

steps.title: Prepare service-recovery runbook
steps.taskDescription: Prepare a local-only containment and recovery checklist; distinguish recommendations from executed operations.
acceptanceCriteria: Document rollback and verification checks
Do not access cloud accounts or deploy changes

outputResult.evidenceSummary: Operator tabletop recommendation (not executed): (1) preserve and time-stamp available logs; (2) validate the synthetic alert and affected test identity; (3) if confirmed in an isolated lab, quarantine that test identity and rotate only its synthetic credential; (4) verify lab authentication and expected denial/recovery; (5) rollback by restoring the lab's recorded pre-exercise policy snapshot and re-run the verification. Production/cloud state, backups, and rollback readiness were not inspected; no cloud account or deployment was accessed.

steps.title: Assess financial impact
steps.taskDescription: Identify which financial facts are needed to assess exposure; report unknown values as unknown.
acceptanceCriteria: Do not fabricate loss estimates or modify ledgers
List required evidence for any estimate

steps.title: Review privacy and personnel impact
steps.taskDescription: Determine what minimum personnel or privacy review would be appropriate for the synthetic event.
acceptanceCriteria: Do not include real personal data
Do not notify or contact employees

steps.title: Draft internal incident update
steps.taskDescription: Prepare an internal-only status draft that clearly marks unknowns and is not sent.
acceptanceCriteria: Label the message as a draft
Do not publish or send communications

steps.title: Identify customer-impact checks
steps.taskDescription: Specify a customer-impact review checklist without querying accounts or contacting customers.
acceptanceCriteria: Use no customer records
Do not send customer communications

steps.title: Approve incident disposition
steps.taskDescription: Review the recorded work packets and explicitly approve or reject the proposed local incident disposition.
acceptanceCriteria: Record an explicit human decision
Approval does not authorize external action or deployment

decisions.title: Allocation of Q3 Autonomous Compute Budget
decisions.objective: Allocate $1,800,000 for high-density GPU model reasoning and continuous discovery sweeps.
evidence: Benchmarked Gemini 3.8 Flash achieving 99.4% accuracy on synthetic task plans at 1/5th the cost of local cluster provisioning.
assumptions: API quotas remain stable at 120 RPM tier.
risks: External vendor rate changes (mitigated by multi-provider model router).
constraints: Must not exceed Angela Martins monthly treasury allocation ceiling.
decisions.expectedOutcome: 35% acceleration in software construction cycle times with zero budget overruns.
decisions.actualOutcome: Exceeded target: achieved 41% speedup with $340k budget surplus.

decisions.title: Remediate Single-Point Approval Bottleneck on Production Deployments
decisions.objective: Establish Risk-Weighted Autonomous Delegation policy; delegate non-breaking config checks to autonomous verification sub-agents.
evidence: Elena Vance and Hank Tate must approve every minor configuration patch; active workload is 94% with 14 blocked tasks queued.
Monolithic authorization rules require Executive Level 80+ sign-off even for low-risk linting and test pipeline updates.
assumptions: Corporate policies permit automated remediation for verified non-destructive tasks
risks: Minor edge case regression handled by instant rollback checkpoint
constraints: Zero downtime allowed in corporate communications

risks: Minor edge case regression handled by instant rollback checkpoint

failures.title: SyntaxError: TypeScript Enum Stripping in Node 22
failures.environmentSummary: Node v22.14.0 on Linux x86_64 running node server.ts with --experimental-strip-types.
failures.rootCause: Node 22 native type-stripping strips type annotations but cannot transpile TypeScript enums into runtime JavaScript objects.
attemptedSolutions: Attempted tsx in production (rejected due to memory footprint and start script contract)
failures.finalSolution: Refactored all enums to immutable const objects using `as const` with companion union types.
failures.preventionStrategy: Added linting rule and updated technical knowledge base (know-02). All future developers must use const object patterns.
